instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 eggplant
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet warms up, peel and small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces; transfer to a small bowl.
Add the ground beef to the skillet; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until crumbly and browned, 2 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer the beef to a bowl and leave the juices in the skillet.
While the beef cooks, peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat the oven to broil and position the rack about 6 inches from the top.
Once the beef has been transferred, add olive oil and the onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: While the onion cooks, trim and discard the ends of the eggplant; medium dice the eggplant into ½-inch cubes and transfer to a medium bowl.
Add the garlic, eggplant, and diced tomatoes to the skillet; season with cinnamon, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the eggplant is tender, 8 to 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (14.5 oz) can diced tomatoes
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the eggplant cooks, in a small saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
While the butter melts, grate ⅛ cup of Parmesan.
Sprinkle in the flour over the melted butter and whisk until the mixture is smooth, 15 to 30 seconds.
Slowly pour the milk into the saucepan, whisking constantly. Cook the sauce, whisking constantly, until thickened, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the Parmesan to the sauce and season with salt and pepper; stir and remove from the heat.
Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves.
Return the ground beef to the skillet and stir in ¾ of the parsley (save the rest for garnishing).
Drizzle the béchamel sauce over the top of the beef and eggplant mixture.
Place the skillet in the oven and broil until the dish is browned on top, 1 to 3 minutes.
To serve, spoon the moussaka into a bowl and sprinkle with the remaining parsley. Enjoy!
